name: The Poisoned Court
about: Heirs are dying at feasts all over the realm, and every cup went through one great lord's hands. Find the poisoner, or you'll be the next one buried.
title: The Poisoned Court

beats.speaker: mourner
beats.text: {first} collapses at the feast in {hall}, clutching {first.his} throat. The physicians say it was a fever. The servants say it wasn't.

memory.mourner: I saw {first} die at the table in {hall}. It was no fever.

court.text: {mourner} of {mourner.house}: "{first} was poisoned, Your Grace. I'd stake my house on it. Someone at that table wanted {first.him} dead."

options.label: Have your own men question every servant (100 gold)
options.result: The King's men go quietly from kitchen to kitchen. Somebody in {hall} stops sleeping well.

options.label: Double the tasters at every royal table (150 gold)
options.hint: your cups are safer · you get no answers
options.result: Every cup at court now goes past two tasters before it reaches the King.

options.label: Take the physicians' word that it was a fever
options.hint: costs nothing now · the poisoner gets bolder
options.result: The crown accepts it was a fever. {mourner} doesn't.

beats.speaker: mourner
text: {second} dies after drinking from a wedding cup, and {mourner} rides to Kingsmere without stopping to bury {second.him}.
Another cup, another grave. This time it's {second}, of {mourner.house}. The great families of the realm start eating only what their own cooks make.

court.text: {mourner}: "Two heirs are dead, Your Grace, and both cups came from {poisoner}'s cellars. Will you name {poisoner.him}, or wait for a third?"

options.label: Accuse {poisoner} in front of the whole court
options.hint: {poisoner.houseName} −30 · right or wrong, you can't take it back
options.result: The King names {poisoner} in front of the court. The hall goes silent, and {poisoner} smiles.

options.label: Plant a spy in {poisoner}'s household (200 gold)
options.hint: you get proof in time · or the spy gets caught
options.result: A new steward joins {poisoner}'s household at {hall}. Nobody recommended him.

options.label: Say nothing until you have proof
options.hint: costs nothing now · the poisoner picks the next cup
options.result: The King waits for proof. {poisoner} sends him a cask of wine for the new year.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: The King had no proof, so the realm turns against the crown instead of {poisoner}. {poisoner.house} calls it tyranny, and people listen.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: The King's taster is found dead in the royal kitchens at dawn. The cup was meant for the King.

court.text: {mourner}, white in the face: "Your Grace, your taster is dead. The next cup is yours. Leave Kingsmere, or end this tonight."

options.label: Slip out of Kingsmere for a season (300 gold)
options.hint: the court is cleaned out while you're gone · the realm sees you run
options.result: The King rides out of Kingsmere in a merchant's cart. Behind him, the kitchens are emptied and the cellars searched.

options.label: Arrest {poisoner} tonight, proof or no proof
options.result: The King's guards drag {poisoner} out of {poisoner.his} bed. The cellars at {hall} are opened.

options.label: Hold the feast anyway, because a King isn't afraid
options.result: The feast goes ahead. The King lifts his cup.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: The King lifts the cup. Down the table, {mourner} freezes.

court.text: {mourner}, across the table, barely moving {mourner.his} lips: "Your Grace. Don't drink that."

options.label: Put the cup down and call the taster (100 gold)
options.hint: the feast is ruined · {poisoner} is watched from now on
options.result: The King puts the cup down untouched. The taster drinks and doesn't get up from the bench. Everyone at the table turns to look at {poisoner}.

options.label: Drink it and shame the gossips
options.hint: the court sees a fearless King · if {mourner} is right, you die
options.result: The King drains the cup and turns it upside down on the table.

beats.text: The King dies at his own table, just like the heirs. {poisoner} cries the loudest at the funeral.

do.fall: The King dies at his own table, poisoned like the heirs before him. {poisoner} weeps loudest at the funeral, and the crown passes to whoever {poisoner.he} chooses.

beats.speaker: mourner
beats.text: The poison turns up in {poisoner}'s cellars at {hall}, with the steward's own hand on it. {poisoner} is taken away in chains, and the realm's cups are safe again.

die.how: the headsman, for poisoning the court

memory.mourner: The King found out who poisoned the heirs, and the dead have their justice.

beats.text: {poisoner} dies, and the poisonings stop. Nobody at court says out loud why.
